meta.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

copy.tagline: 学会在对话中调用技能再回答
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触技能系统，需要了解如何正确调用技能。
copy.tagline_en: Learn to invoke skills before responding in conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to the skill system and need to learn how to invoke skills properly.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在回答任何问题前必须先检查并调用相关技能，包括澄清问题、探索代码库等操作之前。它会先宣布“使用[技能]来[目的]”，然后严格遵循技能指令。
howto.when: 每次对话开始时，或当用户提出任何任务（包括简单问题）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本。
解释一下这个代码库的结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude must check and invoke relevant skills before any response, including clarifying questions or exploring codebase. It announces 'Using [skill] to [purpose]' and follows the skill exactly.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of any conversation or when the user presents any task, including simple questions.

say_en.text: Write a Python script for me.
Explain the structure of this codebase.
